title: Maria Is Sick
text:
Maria has a cold. She has a sore throat and a headache. She stays at home and rests for two days.

Her friend Juan brings her soup and tea. He tells her to drink a lot of water and get some sleep. After two days, Maria feels better.

questions.text: Why does Maria stay at home?
What can we guess about Juan?
options: He is a doctor at the hospital

vocabulary.definition: an illness that makes your nose run and makes you cough
stops working or moving to get energy back
the time when you close your eyes and your body rests

paragraph_translations: María tiene un resfriado. Tiene dolor de garganta y dolor de cabeza. Se queda en casa y descansa durante dos días.
Su amigo Juan le trae sopa y té. Él le dice que beba mucha agua y que duerma bien. Después de dos días, María se siente mejor.
